name: PalletTile
summary: Individual pallet card. Weight + dimensions + hazmat flag + lane assignment + freight class. Mono numerics. Drag-handle slot for kanban-style reassignment. Hazmat flag is amber-tinted with a small ⚠ icon.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER omit weight + dims — they're the load-bearing identity.
NEVER use Pallet for non-freight items (cartons → use CartonTile).
NEVER hide hazmat flag — regulatory requirement.
